stat.title: Sites
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(s.id) as cnt from Site as s left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id left outer join State as st on g.stateId = st.id left outer join Lga as l on g.lgaId = l.id

stat.title: Devices
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(d.id) as cnt from Device as d inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join DeviceType as dt on dt.id = d.deviceTypeId inner join DeviceTypeCategory as dc on dc.id = dt.deviceTypeCategoryId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where dc.hasResults = 1

stat.title: Results
stat.subTitle: Last 30 Days
stat.sqlForIndicator: select ifnull(sum(f.resultCount), 0) as cnt from FactResultsDevice as f inner join Device as d on d.id = f.deviceId inner join Site as s on s.id = d.siteId inner join Partner as p on p.id = s.partnerId left outer join Geography as g on s.geographyId = g.id where f.days = 30

stat.title: Contacts
stat.sqlForIndicator: select count(u.id) as cnt from User as u

stat.title: Confirmed cases
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(f.resultCount), 0) AS cnt FROM factresultsdevicebycategory1 AS f INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = f.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN assay a ON f.`assayId`= a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON f.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid='Positive'

stat.title: Active cases
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT f.id), 0) AS cnt FROM Result AS f INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = f.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN assay a ON f.`assayId`= a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON f.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid='Positive' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ResultFollowUp rfu INNER JOIN followup fu ON fu.`id`=rfu.`followUpId` INNER JOIN followuptype ft ON fu.`followUpTypeId` =ft.id WHERE ft.externalid='outcome' AND rfu.resultId=f.id)

stat.title: Recovered cases
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id),0) AS cnt FROM Result AS r INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN assay a ON r.`assayId` = a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON r.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid = 'Positive' AND EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ResultFollowUp rfu INNER JOIN followup fu ON fu.`id` = rfu.`followUpId` INNER JOIN followuptype ft ON fu.`followUpTypeId` = ft.id WHERE ft.externalid = 'outcome' AND rfu.`resultId` = r.`id` AND fu.`externalId`='Recovered')
stat.sqlForStatUnit: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN r.startedOn>=NOW()-INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN r.startedOn<=NOW()-INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS cnt FROM Result AS r INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN assay a ON r.`assayId` = a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON r.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` INNER JOIN ResultFollowUp rfu ON rfu.`resultId`=r.`id` INNER JOIN followup fu ON fu.`id` = rfu.`followUpId` INNER JOIN followuptype ft ON fu.`followUpTypeId` = ft.id LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid = 'Positive' AND r.`startedOn`>= NOW()-INTERVAL 14 DAY AND ft.externalid = 'outcome' AND fu.`externalId` = 'Recovered'

stat.title: Deaths
stat.sqlForIndicator: SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id),0) AS cnt FROM Result AS r INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN assay a ON r.`assayId` = a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON r.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid = 'Positive' AND EXISTS (SELECT * FROM ResultFollowUp rfu INNER JOIN followup fu ON fu.`id` = rfu.`followUpId` INNER JOIN followuptype ft ON fu.`followUpTypeId` = ft.id WHERE ft.externalid = 'outcome' AND rfu.`resultId` = r.`id` AND fu.`externalId`='Death')
stat.sqlForStatUnit: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN r.startedOn>=NOW()-INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END - CASE WHEN r.startedOn<=NOW()-INTERVAL 7 DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS cnt FROM Result AS r INNER JOIN Device AS d ON d.id = r.deviceId INNER JOIN Site AS s ON s.id = d.siteId INNER JOIN Partner AS p ON p.id = s.partnerId INNER JOIN assay a ON r.`assayId` = a.`id` INNER JOIN ResultCategory rc ON r.resultCategory1 = rc.`id` INNER JOIN ResultFollowUp rfu ON rfu.`resultId`=r.`id` INNER JOIN followup fu ON fu.`id` = rfu.`followUpId` INNER JOIN followuptype ft ON fu.`followUpTypeId` = ft.id LEFT OUTER JOIN Geography AS g ON s.geographyId = g.id WHERE rc.externalid = 'Positive' AND r.`startedOn`>= NOW()-INTERVAL 14 DAY AND ft.externalid = 'outcome' AND fu.`externalId` = 'Death'
